'''Team Europe''' is the European squad in the Players Committee [[Outrider Cup]] series, the biennial Europe versus United States team event on GEMP. The side won [[2021 Outrider Cup]] on a captains' tiebreaker after the 12 regulation games finished 6–6. [[Team USA]] won [[2019 Outrider Cup]], [[2023 Outrider Cup III]], and [[2026 Outrider Cup IV]].

Six players a side is the published format: Player of the Year points plus a captain's pick, unique objectives per team, and a race to seven. Captains have been [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] (2019, 2021) and [[Emil Wallin]] (2023, 2026).

=== 2023 Outrider Cup III ===

Captain [[Emil Wallin]]. Captain's pick: [[Justin Branch]]. 16–28 January 2024. Runner-up, 5–7. Europe tied the series at 5–5 before [[Brian Fred]] and [[Hayes Hunter]] closed it out for Team USA.<ref name="oc23">https://www.starwarsccg.org/outrider-cup-iii-wrap-up-victory-for-team-usa/</ref>

=== 2021 Outrider Cup ===

Captain [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]. November 2021 – 26 January 2022. Winner. After the 12 regulation games finished 6–6, Winkelhaus ([[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] / [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]]) defeated USA captain [[Joe Olson]] in the 26 January 2022 tiebreaker. Winkelhaus was Europe's only 2–0 in regulation; Team USA had come back from a 4–1 deficit to force the extra match.<ref name="oc21">https://www.starwarsccg.org/team-europe-wins-the-2021-outrider-cup/</ref>
